name: Raid bots: a Pyromancer opting in to rotation assistance casts its Incineration priorities in a raid fight
contract: Only the Pyromancer opts in with rotation_assist. Its damage spells come from the .rotation selection
(CoARotationAssist::ChooseSpell) for its active CoA specialization, Incineration (class 24, specialization
38). src/server/coa/CoARotationData.h lists for specialization 38 Ignite while the target misses it, then
Flare Bolt; Fire Blast is not in the profile. The fixture teaches Flare Bolt 800790, Ignite 800791 and Fire
Blast 2137 directly, as rotation-assist-profile does, to isolate selection. Client Spell.dbc
(coa-dbc-viewer record against /home/fab/CoaServer/dbc_clientset, sha256 9d77d79e...): Ignite casts in
1500 ms (SpellCastTimes 16), lasts 21000 ms (SpellDuration 86), 35 yd (SpellRange 35), 12 percent base
mana, periodic damage aura; Flare Bolt casts in 1500 ms, 35 yd, 11 percent, facing required, projectile
speed 35; Fire Blast is instant, 20 yd (SpellRange 3), 8000 ms cooldown, 17 percent, SpellLevel 14, facing
required. All three share global cooldown category 133 (1500 ms). Ignite outlasts the 20000 ms window, so
the rotation casts it once and Flare Bolt fills the remaining global cooldowns. Fire Blast is the
Pyromancer's scenario rotation, the fallback a bot casts without rotation_assist; it is castable in range,
so any fallback would show as a Fire Blast cast; the case asserts that the Pyromancer stays within
its 20 yd range of the boss (2D distance), since a ranged bot casts in place. The tank (Barbarian, class 12,
Ancestral Strike 801576) and the healer (Sun Cleric, class 27, Illumination 500143) keep the
raid-bots-tank-healer fixture without rotation_assist and without a specialization, so they act from their
scenario spells in the same fight.
The boss has 100000 health so the level-14 Pyromancer cannot end the encounter inside the window. All
asserted values come from the harness's own observation of native packets and the encounter timeline.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and local level scaling settle
SETUP: the Pyromancer knows Flare Bolt
SETUP: the Pyromancer knows Fire Blast, its scenario fallback
SETUP: the tank knows its rotation spell
SETUP: the healer knows its heal
CONTROL: no Pyromancer cast before the encounter
Incineration applies Ignite once: it lasts longer than the fight window
The boss carries the Pyromancer's Ignite
Flare Bolt follows while Ignite is active
The Pyromancer stayed within Fire Blast's 20 yd range of the boss
The scenario fallback is never cast: the rotation drives the Pyromancer
No fixture swing at the Pyromancer
The tank kept swinging at the boss
The healer completed at least one heal with its scenario heal_spell
